_comment: Converted from: scripts/run_customer_cdc.ksh — AutoSys job JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC (runs every 4 hours)

_mapping.Step 4: audit_customer_changes.mp: Task: generate_audit — Change Data Feed query
_mapping.RUN_TIMESTAMP: Automatic via job run start time

name: customer_cdc_pipeline
description: Customer CDC pipeline — snapshot → detect changes → apply → audit. Migrated from Ab Initio KornShell orchestration (run_customer_cdc.ksh) triggered by AutoSys JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC every 4 hours.

schedule._comment: Original: AutoSys JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC runs every 4 hours

new_cluster._comment: 8 workers maps to -partition 8 in cdc_detect_customer.mp and PSET PARTITION_COUNT=8

parameters.name: source_path
parameters._comment: Maps to PSET SOURCE_PATH=/data/raw/customer from customer_cdc.pset

parameters.name: hash_columns
parameters._comment: Maps to PSET HASH_COLUMNS from customer_cdc.pset

parameters.name: partition_count
parameters._comment: Maps to PSET PARTITION_COUNT=8 and -partition 8 in KornShell

parameters.name: retention_days
parameters._comment: Maps to PSET RETENTION_DAYS=90 — Delta Lake VACUUM interval

tasks._comment: Step 1 from KornShell: air sandbox run snapshot_customer.mp -pset customer_snapshot.pset
tasks.description: Step 1: Snapshot current state from source. Replaces: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/snapshot_customer.mp

tasks._comment: Steps 2+3 from KornShell: cdc_detect_customer.mp + apply_customer_changes.mp combined into Delta MERGE
tasks.description: Steps 2-3: Detect changes and apply via Delta MERGE. Replaces: cdc_detect_customer.mp (-partition 8) + apply_customer_changes.mp

tasks._comment: Step 4 from KornShell: air sandbox run audit_customer_changes.mp — replaced by Delta Change Data Feed query
tasks.description: Step 4: Generate audit trail. Replaces: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/audit_customer_changes.mp. Uses Delta Lake Change Data Feed instead of a separate audit graph.

query.query_string: INSERT INTO lakehouse.audit.customer_changes SELECT *, current_timestamp() AS audit_timestamp FROM table_changes('lakehouse.bronze.customer', (SELECT MAX(version) - 1 FROM (DESCRIBE HISTORY lakehouse.bronze.customer LIMIT 2)))

tasks._comment: Cleanup — equivalent to RETENTION_DAYS=90 in customer_cdc.pset
tasks.description: Cleanup: VACUUM old Delta versions. Maps to PSET RETENTION_DAYS=90.

email_notifications._comment: Replaces KornShell exit code propagation + AutoSys failure notification

_comment_max_concurrent: Equivalent to AutoSys mutual exclusion — prevent overlapping CDC runs
